title: hermesVPS phase-060 triage payload
description: Structured machine-readable output of phase 060 (validate-and-triage). Defines the in-scope candidate inventory for generate-findings.

source_commit.description: Full 40-char lowercase hex SHA of the inspected source commit; must equal run.json source.commit

assessed_report_ids.description: Artifact IDs of the phase-040 / phase-050 reports used as input

candidates.description: Validated candidate security issues identified during triage

candidate_id.description: Stable candidate identifier (e.g. C-001). Must be unique within this payload.

source_phase.description: Which upstream phase produced this candidate (040 or 050)

source_finding_ref.description: Reference to the upstream finding in the 040/050 report

existing_sg_id.description: Existing SG-NNN ID if disposition is existing-record or duplicate
